summary.text: Barclay Woerner is the Republican candidate for the Iowa House of Representatives, District 79, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which incumbent Tracy Ehlert (D) is also running.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026, and works in management.

paragraphs.text: Barclay Woerner was born in St. Louis, Missouri, and graduated from Parkway North High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree from William Jewell College in 1993 and a graduate degree from the University of Iowa in 2013.
